column1: # Opening x25519:v1 (the domain envelopes contract, «Envelope x25519:v1»): open(seed_hex, envelope, member, source_path, item, pointer) → a value or a word.
# seed_hex — the seed_secret of the book acceptance key (domain/book-seal); envelope — as it came; the AAD context — member, source_path, item, pointer.
# expect — the opened value as a JSON string or the refusal word not_v1 | not_an_envelope | does_not_open; the order of checks: not_v1 → not_an_envelope → does_not_open.
# The rows — the acceptance inputs of M11/2 inputs/seal-*.json (case — the file name), the expectations — sc. 08–10 scenarios.tsv.

column9: control: its own book acceptance key and its own context — a value (UTF-8 outside ASCII)
an empty value is sealed and opened too
the seed of another book acceptance key (book seal 2) — does not open
eph — the zero point: a zero shared secret
a character of ct changed — AEAD does not open
ct 15 bytes — shorter than the tag
Non-ASCII UTF-8 and «/», «~» in item; pointer with ~1 and an index — AAD by JCS and the path rule
non-canonical base64url: nonzero trailing bits of the last character
